correctness.rationale: A finite flag-complex fixed-locus barycentric argument and exact reduced Lefschetz theorem reduce each of 11 S6 conjugacy classes to the signed independence polynomial of an explicitly finite incompatibility graph. All graphs and complete deletion recurrences are generated with a reproducible standalone exact checker; different pivot orders agree. The Murnaghan–Nakayama class projections have integral coefficients, exact dimension 253, and trivial multiplicity seven; independent 11x11 character orthogonality check passed. Rational quotient homology invariants prove reduced Euler −7. No infinite extension or graded-module claim is asserted.

value.rationale: The first intermediate hypercube Rips equivariance case (6,4) was left outside published all-scale character ranges. Computing all 11 coordinate-conjugacy classes refines both the scalar Betti data and translation-subgroup character on the exact same complex, and the multiplicity of invariants determines a genuine geometric symmetry-quotient Euler characteristic not inferable from a fixed-space or nonequivariant rank alone. This is a motivated exact finite equivariant classification, with a reusable orbit-graph method.
